notes.content:
Note: This version update will affect the archive of the old version.After the update, you need to delete the old version archive in the settings, otherwise there will be a problem of not displaying some trap information.
Solution: 1. Overall increase the experience value and the number of gold coins obtained.
               2. This version adds a console.
                ctrl+1    Increase gold coins
                ctrl+2    Level up
                ctrl+4    Pass directly（Press the number on the keypad first）

Optimize the interface ui effect 
Brave part of the range of skills to reduce the range 
Slightly reduce the number of heroes 
Increase the damage of the brave 
Increase the life of some monsters 
Reduce the price of some high-end Warcraft 
The description of the staff is displayed when the staff is picked up
Optimized Thunder Staff, added splitting effect 
Optimized the effect of Wind Spirit Staff, changed to continuous damage 
Optimized the healing staff and changed it to area healing.
Increase the duration of the ladder staff.
Replace the trap "Goddess of Life" with "Dagger Tower" (four rotating swords) 
The attack method of the trap ‘ice pool’ has been changed from ‘ice bomb’ to ‘ice fountain’ for continuous range damage. 
Warcraft ‘Stone Demon’ optimizes the effect of attacking stones, 
Expansion of the cannonball contact range of the "Ghost Ship" of Warcraft 
When the Warcraft "King Slime" is attacked, it has a chance to drop baby slimes. 
Warcraft ‘Baby Slime’ will grow into a random type of slime after a period of time. 
Warcraft ‘Life Slime’ lowers the price, lowers the attack: 30→25, lowers life, and narrows the range of skills. 
Warcraft "Towering Tree Demon" adds passive healing skills
The effect of the skill ‘e’ has been changed to attract the hatred of nearby heroes.

优化部分魔法技能视觉效果
新增玩家40级弓箭爆炸效果
优化关卡24
冰冻陷阱3级、4级，新增范围减速技能
召唤陷阱 缩短cd时间

Optimize the visual effects of some magic skills
Added player level 40 bow and arrow explosion effect
Optimize level 24
Frozen Trap Level 3, 4, new range deceleration skills
Summon a trap to shorten the cd time

优化整体魔法视觉效果
优化整体角色材质
优化整体角色动画
降低整体魔法速度
机械大剑伤害降低40→30  技能持续时间延长2s→4s
牧师新增技能‘禁锢’ 
新增可破坏坛子类型  治疗史莱姆皇。
优化关卡2场景

Optimize the overall magic visual effect
Optimize the overall character material
Optimize the overall character animation
Reduce overall magic speed
Mechanical sword damage reduced by 40→30, skill duration increased by 2s→4s
Priest’s new skill "Imprisonment"
Added a new type of destructible jars to heal the slime king.
Optimize the level 2 scene

新增关卡23《黑暗》、关卡24《对峙》
双手剑右键攻击可以连续释放
略微降低关卡勇者数量

Added level 23 "Darkness" and level 24 "Confrontation"
Two-handed sword right-click attack can be released continuously
Slightly reduce the number of level heroes

1.近战魔兽增加被动嘲讽技能（宝箱怪、骷髅战士、巨石傀儡、兽王战士、岩石史莱姆、骷髅王、狂暴野兽、参天树妖、尖锐恶魔、寒冰巨龙、暗黑火龙。）
2.整体调整魔兽攻击与生命值。
3.优化场景物品、掉落物品碰撞效果。
4.优化陷阱描述文字。
5.缩短召唤之门cd时间，优化召唤之门效果。
6.提高火焰陷阱伤害、略微扩大火焰范围。
7.缩短旋转箭塔cd时间。
8.缩短箭塔cd时间。
9.提高陷阱寒冰池减速效果，提高攻击速度。
10.缩短远程攻击魔兽的巡逻距离。

1. Increased passive taunting skills for melee warcraft(Treasure box monster, skeleton warrior, boulder puppet, beastmaster warrior, rock slime, skeleton king, violent beast, towering tree monster, sharp demon, ice dragon, dark fire dragon.)
2. Adjust the overall attack and life value of monsters.
3. Optimize the collision effect of scene items and falling items.
4. Optimize the trap description text
5. Shorten the cd time of the door of summoning and optimize the effect of the door of summoning.
6. Increase the damage of the flame trap and slightly expand the flame range.
7. Shorten the cd time of the rotating arrow tower.
8. Shorten the cd time of Arrow Tower.
9. Improve the deceleration effect of the trap ice pool and increase the attack speed.
10. Shorten the patrol distance for long-range attacks on Warcraft.

优化魔兽ai逻辑，丢失目标后不再跟随。
新增技能“标记”，魔兽会优先攻击被标记的敌人，键盘“e”键使用。
略微调整玩家视角
新增弓箭命中效果
优化玩家血量ui颜色

Optimize the logic of Warcraft ai, no longer follow after losing the target.
The new skill "Mark" is added, the monsters will give priority to attacking the marked enemies, and the keyboard "e" key is used.
Slightly adjust the player's perspective.
Added bow and arrow hit effect.
Optimize the player's blood volume ui color.

新增关卡21、22，通关后解锁。
优化关卡光效，解决图像设置较低情况下，太过黑暗问题。
大剑士技能优化，新增技能旋转剑刃。
火法师技能优化，新增技能火墙。
火龙新增技能，喷火。
刺客新增技能，穿刺。
野蛮人新增动作，旋转攻击。

Added new levels 21 and 22, which will be unlocked after clearing.
Optimize the light effect of the level to solve the problem of too dark when the image setting is low.
Optimized the skill of Great Swordsman, and added the skill to rotate the blade.
The fire mage skills are optimized, and the fire wall of skills is added.
Fire Dragon's new skill, Spitfire.
Assassin’s new skill, piercing.
New action for barbarians, spin attack.

新增幽灵船火炮技能音效
解决幽灵船技能火炮在部分地面不爆炸问题
大幅减少勇者数量
提高勇者伤害
提高勇者移动速度
提高魔兽伤害


Added ghost ship artillery skill sound effects
Solve the problem that the ghost ship skill artillery does not explode on part of the ground
Significantly reduce the number of brave men
Increase the damage of brave
Increase the movement speed of the brave
Increase the damage of Warcraft

骷髅战士、弓箭手、法师死亡时，召唤骨牢。
骷髅王死亡时，所在位置召唤巨型骨牢。
死亡时显示倒计时。
新增 游戏进度条，默认隐藏，按ctrl键显示。
解决双手剑技能2不破坏场景物品问题。
缩短整体游戏时间，
提高史莱姆皇移动速度100→120，
略微降低勇者生命，略微提高勇者攻击。

When the skeleton warrior, archer, and wizard die, summon the bone prison.
When the Skeleton King dies, the location summons a giant bone prison.
Show countdown when dying
Added game progress bar, hidden by default, press ctrl key to display it.
Solve the problem that the two-handed sword skill 2 does not destroy the scene items.
Shorten the overall game time,
Increase the movement speed of King Slime by 100→120
Slightly reduce the hero's life, slightly increase the hero's attack

1.0.3

游戏内可以获得金币
火焰史莱姆死亡时 生成火墙  持续造成伤害5s
寒冰史莱姆死亡时 生成冰刺  持续造成伤害并减速3s
岩石史莱姆死亡时 生成眩晕  造成伤害并眩晕
治疗史莱姆死亡时 生成生命爆发  造成2倍伤害并治疗队友
解决魔法箭卡住bug
优化召唤魔兽效果
略微增大史莱姆体积

Gold coins can be obtained in the game
When the flame slime dies, a wall of fire is generated, causing damage for 5 seconds.
When the ice slime dies, it generates ice thorns, causing continuous damage and slowing for 3s
When the rock slime dies, it generates a stun, causes damage and stuns.
When the healing slime dies, it generates a burst of life, deals 2 times the damage and heals teammates
Solve the magic arrow stuck bug
Optimize the effect of summoning monsters
Slightly increase the size of the slime

1.0.2 

大幅降低map1的难度，略微降低整体难度
解决史莱姆皇因碰撞(阻挡)无法前进的问题
略微调整勇者与魔兽基础属性
降低击杀勇者掉落的灵魂数
降低石魔的价格80→40，
提高巨石傀儡价格110→130
提高恶魔之眼价格30→50，技能增加治疗效果，增加被动治疗技能，
优化音效

Significantly reduce the difficulty of map1 and slightly reduce the overall difficulty
Solve the problem that the King Slime cannot move forward due to collision (blocking)
Slightly adjusted the basic attributes of Brave and Warcraft
Reduce the number of souls dropped by killing heroes
Reduce the price of the golem by 80→40
Increase the price of the boulder golem by 110 → 130
Increase the price of Demon Eye by 30→50, increase the healing effect of skills, and increase passive healing skills.
Optimize sound

1.0.1---
增加帮助页面“H”
略微提高攻击速度
降低关卡1难度
提高初始灵魂数 50→80
优化血条显示
玩家低血量心跳提醒

Add help page“H”
Slightly increase attack speed
Reduce the difficulty of map 1
Increase the initial number of souls by 50→80
Optimize the display of health bars
Player low blood volume heartbeat reminder
